summary:
As the player makes engineering and mission planning decisions, dynamic on-screen meters evaluate the spacecraft's performance in real-time across four key metrics:
Impact: The potential scientific or societal value of the chosen mission objectives.
Creativity: The uniqueness and innovation of the spacecraft's design and problem-solving approach.
Validity: The physical and scientific feasibility of the mission, cross-referenced against the integrated NASA data.
Tech Stack: The combination of hardware, instruments, and software systems equipped on the vessel.
The demo highlights how players interact with authentic space data to balance these four elements, blending educational simulation with strategic gameplay.
details: Mission Architect is an interactive, browser-based space mission design game and engineering portal powered by live NASA open data. Players step into the role of Lead Mission Systems Engineer—selecting real planets or Near-Earth Asteroids, designing spacecraft subsystems within strict physical budgets, optimizing interplanetary trajectories on a live Lambert-solved Porkchop Plot, and piloting their probe through real NASA DONKI solar storms.
